title: Posetal Games: Efficiency, Existence, and Refinement of Equilibria in Games with Prioritized Metrics
reasoning: The paper focuses on game theory and motion planning for autonomous vehicles. It introduces a mathematical framework (Posetal Games) to handle prioritized objectives. While it mentions 'liability, ethics, and culture-aware behavior' as motivations for why robots must follow human rules, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical systems.
